color.$description: Light-mode semantic color roles — aliases onto primitive ramps. Dark mode lives in color.dark.tokens.json; mode-independent colors in color.fixed.tokens.json. Role keys apply the neutralized vocabulary: surfaceSecondary/onSurfaceSecondary replace the former secondaryContainer/onSecondaryContainer, and borderSubtle replaces the former outlineVariant. primary/secondary/tertiary are PLACEHOLDERS aliasing the neutral ramp until a chromatic brand accent exists; note that the foundation primary/secondary 400 step was #b6b6b6 whereas neutral.400 is #ababab, so aliasing onto neutral shifts that one step — accepted divergence rather than inventing a new ramp.

primary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp — no chromatic brand accent yet. Re-point or de-alias when a brand hue exists.

secondary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp pending a chromatic brand accent.

tertiary.$description: PLACEHOLDER: aliases the neutral ramp pending a chromatic brand accent.

onSurfaceSecondary.$description: Foreground on the tonal/secondary surface. Neutralized name (was onSecondaryContainer).
